title: NASA Saturn satellite sheet: Tethys (III) mass 6.18×10^20 kg, radius 538 x 528 x 526 km
summary: The Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Tethys (III) at mass 6.18 × 10^20 kg and radius 538 x 528 x 526 km.
body: NASA's Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Tethys (III) with mass 6.18 × 10^20 kg, radius 538 x 528 x 526 km, mean density 985 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.8. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 294.66; Semi-major axis (Saturnian Radii) = 4.8892; Orbital Period* (days) = 1.887802; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 1.86; Eccentricity = 0.0000. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 22 July 2025.
